question: Subaru’s wallet seems like it would have old 500 yen coins and 2000 yen bills, doesn’t it. (note: 500 yen coin design was changed in the year 2000)
answer: He probably collected all kinds of grooved 10 yen coins, indeed. He might have a lot of coins from the 64th year of the Showa era. (note: due to an era change, Showa 64 was only a week long)
